title: Lead AI Engineer, Agentic Systems - Capco AI Lab
description: We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to join Capco's AI Frontier Lab, based in Paris. The Lab builds agentic AI solutions for clients in financial services and energy, and advises them on AI architecture and governance. The engineering team is already in place. What's missing is a senior technical lead who owns the architecture, reviews and shapes the team's work, still writes code, and can represent those technical decisions directly to the client. What you'll do Lead the engineering (~40%) Own the architecture of our agentic solutions end to end: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory and state, retrieval, evaluation, observability, plus the cost and latency budgets that decide whether a system survives contact with production. Guide our engineers through design reviews, pairing and code review, raising the bar rather than quietly doing the work for them. Set the standards: reference architectures, agentic patterns, guardrails, testing and eval strategy, CI/CD for non-deterministic systems, deployment topology. Make the build/buy/adapt calls on frameworks, models and platforms, and be able to defend them a year later. Stay hands-on (~30%) Prototype fast, and build the hard parts yourself: the tricky orchestration, the eval harness, the integration nobody else wants to touch. Take promising prototypes to production grade, covering reliability, monitoring, versioning, rollback and human-in-the-loop where it matters. Work with clients (~30%) Act as our senior technical voice in solution discussions, workshops and pitches, translating between business outcomes and system design in both directions. Advise on AI architecture, platform strategy, model and vendor strategy, and governance as they actually apply to a client's operating model. Produce content that carries weight: reference architectures, points of view, whitepapers, and talks at client forums and conferences. What we're looking for Essential 8+ years in software or data engineering, including genuine enterprise architecture experience. You've designed systems that had to survive security review, integration hell and real production traffic. You still write code, and you'd be comfortable opening a pull request in your second week. Strong Python or equivalent. Demonstrable agentic AI experience: agentic loops and orchestration, tool use and function calling, multi-agent patterns, MCP or comparable integration approaches, and, critically, how you evaluate AI solutions. Depth on at least one major cloud platform, with the surrounding discipline: containers, IaC, observability, security. Presence with clients. You can hold a room of senior stakeholders, disagree respectfully, and explain a trade-off without retreating into jargon. A real interest in making other engineers better. This role is measured partly by what the team can do without you. Valuable additions Domain experience in financial services or energy, and an understanding of what regulation means for system design in those sectors. A consulting or client-facing delivery background. Open-source contributions, publications, or a speaking track record. Hands-on AI governance, risk or assurance work. French alongside fluent English. What we offer A Lab with a real mandate and real clients. The work ships, and you'll see it running. Influence over technical direction from day one, not after a two-year wait. The rare combination of deep engineering and senior advisory work, without having to give up either. title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
description: Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner ! Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses ! Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant. Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous ! L'opportunité: HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients. Vos missions: Construire et développer une équipe produit performante Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France. Définir et challenger la vision produit Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français. Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes. Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact. Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence. Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale. Aligner produit et stratégie marketing Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente. Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi. Votre profil: Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement. Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables. description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English About the role: We are looking for a visionary Director, Biopharma Data Science to champion the development of our AI Scientist, an agentic system designed to navigate the complexities of target and drug discovery. You will lead a squad of data/research/AI scientists at the interface of machine learning and computational biology, working as both builders of and expert internal users of Owkin's K Pro platform on real scientific use cases. You’ll be at the heart of Owkin’s mission, collaborating with Owkin’s scientists and/or external collaborators (academic researchers/ pharmaceutical companies) to deliver our strategic projects, and creating the engine that will discover the next generation of life-saving therapeutics. This role is about building a "scientist in a box" that can reason over biological data, design experiments, and autonomously drive therapeutic breakthroughs. In particular, you will: Co-build the development of Owkin's AI Scientist, across two complementary discovery paradigms: data-first discovery (deriving targets and pharmaceutical insights from multimodal patient data, across modalities and stages of clinical development) and knowledge-first discovery (generating and testing novel scientific hypotheses grounded in the scientific literature, then validating them on data). Lead and/or contribute to projects aiming to discover novel drug targets, biomarkers and disease subtypes through reverse translation based on patients’ multi-omics and pre-clinical data (genomics, transcriptomics -spatial, single-cell, bulk-, proteomics, and others) via multimodal analyses and machine / deep learning algorithms. Collaborate closely with your biomedical team colleagues (biologists, MDs, computational chemists) and with Owkin's broader Research & Technology team (agentic engineers, software engineers, ML engineers, and others). Contribute scientific input to help anticipate and shape the tools and capabilities our pharmaceutical partners will need, in coordination with Owkin's client-facing teams. Communicate your scientific results internally and externally. Participate in extending Owkin's methodology, including but not limited to regular literature review. Develop and retain a high performing and engaged scientists team. About you: The successful candidate is independent, deeply curious, and obsessed with the idea of automating the scientific method. You don’t just wait for the perfect dataset, you build the tools to have it. Core Requirements: Technical Foundation: PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or Data Science, Computer Science, Machine Learning but with strong knowledge of Computational Biology (or equivalent high-level industry experience). Deep expertise on multimodal datasets, especially on different omics modalities (bulkRNA seq, single cell, spatial transcriptomic, WGS, WES, GWAS, proteomics, …). The Toolkit: Expert-level Python skills with a focus on "building". Comfortable writing clean, modular code that interfaces with complex APIs and databases. Publication Record: History of contributions to top-tier journals and conferences. Communication: Ability to explain complex agent behaviors to both AI and biological experts. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Fluent in English (French is a plus). Stakeholder Management: Able to manage expectations from stakeholders at all levels, including cross-functional teams within Owkin. Team first, highly collaborative mindset. Preferred Qualifications (The "Big Plus") Expertise in Agentic AI: Deep understanding of LLM reasoning (Chain-of-Thought, ReAct), long-context management, and tool-augmented generation. Transverse knowledge: Good understanding or previous experience on other data modalities relevant for medical purposes and drug discovery (H&E, EHR, …) Systems Engineering: Experience training and deploying large-scale models and managing complex multi-agent orchestrations. Causal Inference: Experience in understanding "response to treatment" and causal discovery in biological systems. Industry Impact: Proven track record of taking a research concept and turning it into a functional tool used by other scientists. To facilitate and ensure that common specifications and procedures are implemented and used in all sections and ESCs – the Drugs QA Leader focuses on the coordination within the ESCs. To participate to external networks/meetings with other key international actors (UNICEF, WHO, ICRC…) sharing the objectives to improve quality of medicines on the international market. The Drugs QA Leader builds and maintains external collaborations linked to quality related topics. III. PURPOSE OF THE JOB Lead the MSF Drug Quality Assurance activities in order to identify new quality sources of drug supply, consolidate the MSF drug QA system to ensure quality, safe and efficacious medicines are used by MSF patients and achieve a coordinated approach towards quality medicines within the ESCs to increase synergies and gains efficiency, as well as monitor international regulatory developments and dynamics that may have an impact on MSF. Coordinates with SPINCO and working groups for any inclusion or changes to MSF catalogues and coordinates the QA/supply check related to new medicines requests. Ensures proper updating and storage and communicates changes to the relevant pharmacists (IMES, IPC, pharma network). Organizes the section pharmacists’ annual product dossier audit on the implementation of MSF Qualification Scheme carried out together with the ESCs. Writes the annual report of the QA activities (products approved/not approved/exceptionally approved/products monitored and variations assessed, etc.) Acts as QA lead for drugs as delegated by the OCs: Coordinates product qualification activities within the IPC team: IMES meetings and follow-up of the action points, assigns and monitors dossier assessment progress, final review. Ensures approval of product dossiers (including variations & monitoring) and Declaration of Equivalence (DoE). Maintains quality reviews in UniQuality for the following approval routes: MSF qualification, WHO PQ and DOEs (to SRAs, to WHO PQ and to PSS). Prepares documentation for DirMeds decision on exceptional validations, route M, of dossiers. Performs the annual risk analysis for prioritization of audits, TVs and MVs planning and supports the IPC in the elaboration of the plan. Participates to manufacturing site audits and performs technical/monitoring visits as per plan. Additional ad hoc support may be provided in other specific TVs for specific country contexts. Briefs and coachs newcomers (section pharmacists, intersectional, AC/APH or ESC pharmacists) on MSF QMS, Qualification Scheme and product dossier assessments. Provides technical guidance and support to the ESCs pharmacists on QA and procurement. Key focal point for Working groups (including malaria WG), to ensure they have regular and efficient support: Is the MSF focal point for antimalarial medicines internally (SPs, ESCs, AC) and externally (manufacturers, ext. actors). Participates in the work of the malaria contact group, including: update on latest developments in treatments, international recommendations and initiatives; availability and potential procurement problems. Updates technical information in UniQuality anti-malaria medicines reviews. Revises regularly with the working groups (malaria contact group or others) the list of priority medicines, for which quality sources need to be identified for MSF. Acts as focal point with working groups with no dedicated pharmacist in any pharma related issue. Liaise with WatSans to ensure updated information on waste management is available for all medicines, by providing technical input on the nature of each molecule. Supports the IPC on specific requests or dossiers. V. PROBLEM-SOLVING Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act. description: About us Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce. Take on searches across any part of the business, moving between GTM, G&A, Product, and Engineering depending on where our hiring priorities sit. You'd typically be running 5 to 7 live roles at a time. Source actively for most of your roles, as that's where the majority of our pipeline comes from. We're an AI company, so we encourage AI-native work here rather than something you squeeze in on the side. About You You have 5+ years of recruiting experience, in-house, embedded, or agency-side, with a proven range across very different functions rather than depth in a single vertical. What matters to us is that you've owned searches end-to-end and partnered directly with hiring managers, not just delivered shortlists. You get up to speed quickly on functions you haven't hired for before, using hiring manager conversations, market research, and your own judgment rather than waiting to be taught. You have a strong track record in proactive sourcing and can walk us through hard searches you've filled in the past, including how you built the pipeline. You're an excellent communicator and a proven closer, comfortable holding your own with senior stakeholders across any function. You're hands-on with tools and automation. You can point to something you built, automated, or streamlined that made your hiring work faster or better, whether that's an ATS workflow, a sourcing automation, or an AI-assisted part of your process. We use Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Claude. You're based in or around Paris, comfortable with regular on-site collaboration, and can start within a short notice period. description: This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. We collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Regional Operations, Rider Marketing and the Retention team to secure and retain a high-quality fleet. You will have overall accountability of our rider referral program from strategy to execution. You’ll partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring incentive spend across the rider lifecycle is efficient, well-targeted, and joined up. You will also own performance tracking of rider hours end-to-end, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives, and working with Data Science to attribute causality to that work – giving senior stakeholders an accurate, defensible read on how our supply investments are performing. Finally, you will own our rider applicant target-setting model which is used to determine our rider acquisition forecasts vs top-down targets, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams. Improvements here will ensure we’re able to plan for longer time horizons with greater degrees of accuracy as well as scenario planning with our Rider Marketing team to drive efficiencies in cost per applicant. Causal Attribution : Partner with Data Science to attribute causality to individual initiatives’ contribution to rider hours, building a robust and defensible measurement framework. Senior Stakeholder Reporting : Ensure rider hours performance and initiative impact are reported accurately and clearly to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence. Weekly Applicant Target Setting : Own the weekly rider applicant target-setting process, ensuring targets reflect the latest view of demand, funnel performance, and onboarding capacity. Annual Planning : Lead applicant target setting within the annual planning cycle, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams to work back from onboard targets to applicant targets. Scenario Planning & Cost Efficiency : Run scenario planning with the Rider Marketing team to stress-test target and budget assumptions and identify opportunities to drive down cost per applicant. Cross-Functional Partnership : Build strong working relationships across Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to keep incentive, performance, and target-setting decisions aligned. Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience in forecasting, target setting, and/or causal measurement. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Data Science, Regional Operations, and Marketing to align on targets and reporting. title: Director of Product Marketing and Market Research
description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: POSITION OVERVIEW Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift. The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business. Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption. RESPONSIBILITIES Product marketing strategy Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement. Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution. Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution. Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market. Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution. Market research and customer insights Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business. Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence. Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input. Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy. Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read. Team and function leadership Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability. Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly. Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer. Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions. REQUIREMENTS Professional knowledge and experience 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles. Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function. Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work. Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing. Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one. Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit. Skills and capabilities Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient. Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs. Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction. Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy. Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality. Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone. Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator. AI fluency AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated. title: Software Architect
description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. Lead Software Architect At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. Why this role matters now This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded. So, what’s the role all about? We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must: Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools. Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality. Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies. Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process. Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview. Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI. Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not. How will you make an impact? You will be responsible for: Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs. Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach. Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time. Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases. Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards. Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs. Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions. Have you got what it takes? Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code. Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs. Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions. Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams. Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar. Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines. Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization. Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar. Good knowledge of SOLID principles. Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility. Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided. Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it. Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain. Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months. You will have an advantage if you also have: Security best practice (OWASP top ten) Azure SQL Server DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub Windows services Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar. Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets). What we do not require We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability. About the interview process The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge. description: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. What does the team work on? Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow. What is the role? Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. You will contribute across frontend and backend systems, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. You will build and evolve APIs and microservices, and help integrate modern AI capabilities into production experiences where they add clear user value. The role requires strong technical judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to move from concept through delivery in a fast-paced environment. How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We use AI agents and smart tooling across brainstorming, planning, analysis, and implementation. People set the direction, exercise judgment, and own the outcomes. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agentic frameworks — and can describe projects where you shipped real customer-facing work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, validate its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. title: Senior Accountant - IFRS
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Accountant, you will: Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed. Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process. Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership. Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate. Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios. Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments. Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors. A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency. The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment. Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards. Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity. Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting. The location This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience. Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders. Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description: Sales Development Representative Edinburgh Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases. The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture Define and develop avionics system architectures , including electronics, data handling, and communication functions. Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements . Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware. Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost. Communications & Data Handling Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts . Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures. Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints. Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses. Integration & Interface Management Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.). Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces. Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders. External Regulatory & Certification Leadership Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification. Verification & Validation Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems. Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities. Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions. Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements. Requirements Engineering Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements . Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation. Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans. Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams. title: Qualitätsmanager (m/w/d) - Lieferantenqualität & Produktprüfung
description: Es ist Feierabend und du verlässt das Office, happy und mit einem starken Gefühl. Dein erster Tag bei PRESCH war einfach stark 🔥 Du hast dir das Sortiment angesehen: über 500 aktive Artikel, vom Hammer bis zum Säbelsägeblatt, Lieferanten über halb Asien verteilt, Verkauf in mehr als zwanzig Länder. Und du hast sofort gesehen, wo das System noch fehlt. Nicht weil hier niemand hinschaut — sondern weil bisher niemand die Aufgabe hatte, aus einzelnen Prüfungen eine Systematik zu machen. Genau das wird deine Aufgabe. Wir erweitern unsere Qualitätssicherung deutlich, weil wir immer mehr eigene Produkte entwickeln. Du bekommst keine fertige Struktur vorgesetzt, du entwirfst sie 💪 Und du merkst schnell: Hier wird nicht geredet, hier wird gemacht. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen am selben Tag. Aufgaben 🛠️ Du gibst frei — oder eben nicht. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts. 🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern. 🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch. 🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben. 🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken. 🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten. 🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. title: Director, GTM Strategy & Planning at Sprout Social
description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Director, GTM Strategy & Planning to lead the team that builds the plans behind how our revenue organization is structured, sized, and targeted. 

 Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team? 

 At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact. 

 As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth. 

 In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work. 

 What you’ll do 

 
 Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor a team spanning GTM strategy, planning, and variable compensation—setting clear objectives, running performance management, and driving hiring. 
 GTM Strategy, Planning & Execution: Run the end-to-end annual and in-year GTM planning cycles. Own the integrated bottom-up pipeline model, reconcile it with Finance’s top-down forecast, and build repeatable frameworks to evaluate emerging routes to market (PLG, partners, self-service) using TAM/SAM analysis. 
 Capacity, Coverage & Segmentation Modeling: Design and optimize segmentation, coverage, and headcount models across enterprise, commercial, and self-service motions. Pressure-test cross-functional capacity plans across SE, CS, and PS to ensure full revenue factory alignment. 
 Quota Deployment, Design & Territory Planning: Lead equitable quota setting and territory design across segments, including book-of-business cuts for expansion and customer teams to maximize revenue potential. 
 Variable Compensation Ownership: Oversee variable comp planning and operations. Design incentive structures that drive target seller behaviors, model payout scenarios, and manage the operational payout and dispute cycle in partnership with Finance and HR. 
 Cross-Functional & Strategic Advisory: Serve as the GTM Strategy representative on the Pricing Council to model revenue/attainment impacts. Partner with field ops on QBR/executive materials and apply practical AI use cases to elevate team productivity. 
 

 What you’ll bring 

 Sprout Social is looking for an analytically rigorous, growth-minded planning leader who builds models that hold up under pressure—and can explain them clearly to senior stakeholders. You are a collaborative partner who excels at translating complex business strategy into actionable operational plans. 

 The minimum qualifications for this role include: 

 
 10–12+ years of experience in GTM strategy, revenue operations, or management consulting within B2B SaaS/enterprise tech, including 3+ years managing and developing teams. 
 Proven track record leading end-to-end GTM planning, including quota design, territory allocation, TAM/SAM sizing, headcount capacity modeling, and sales segmentation at scale. 
 Hands-on ownership of variable compensation strategy and operations, including plan design, cost-of-sales modeling, dispute resolution, and payout execution. 
 

 Preferred qualifications for this role include: 

 
 Experience planning across complex, mixed motions (enterprise field, product-led, partner, and self-service) or navigating significant organizational reorganizations. 
 Fluency with modern revenue tech stacks, including Salesforce, incentive compensation tools (Everstage, CaptivateIQ, Spiff, etc.), planning platforms (Anaplan, Fullcast), and BI environments. 
 Track record of leveraging AI or automation workflows to streamline planning cycles and drive measurable field productivity gains. 
 

 How you’ll grow 

 Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including: 

 
 Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training and onboarding program to build a broad understanding of our products and organization. 
 Build deep relationships with your direct reports, your leader, and your Finance, GTM Analytics, and sales operations partners. 
 Map the current state of segmentation, coverage, quota, and capacity models—and where the assumptions are weakest. 
 Take ownership of in-flight planning deliverables. 
 

 Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by: 

 
 Publishing the planning calendar and operating cadence for the next cycle, with clear inputs, owners, and decision points. 
 Delivering a defensible capacity and coverage analysis for the enterprise and lower-market motions. 
 Inheriting the variable comp function cleanly—payout accuracy and timeliness uninterrupted—while forming a clear view of where plan mechanics and operational rigor should evolve for the next plan year. 
 Taking ownership of the bottom-up pipeline model as the shared source of truth across Sales, Marketing, BD, and Partners. 
 

 Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through: 

 
 Running the annual planning cycle end to end—segmentation, headcount, quota, and territory—landed on time and with leadership aligned. 
 Delivering an integrated bottom-up and top-down view of revenue growth potential alongside Finance. 
 Becoming the person Sales and Finance bring their hardest planning questions to before decisions get made. 
 

 Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by: 

 
 Running a planning function leadership trusts by default, with models that hold up under executive scrutiny. 
 Demonstrating measurable improvement in quota attainment distribution and capacity productivity. 
 Reducing planning cycle time while raising the quality of the output, and growing your team’s capability along the way. 
 

 Of course, what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager. 

 Our Benefits Program 

 We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program: 

 
 Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents. 
 Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources. 
 Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match). 
 Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind. 
 Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year. 
 Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family. 
 Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being. 
 Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet. 
 Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations. 
 Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line . 
 

 * This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits. 

 Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter. 

 Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills. 

 Our current hiring range for this role: $200,000– $250,000 OTE annually. OTE is governed by an incentive plan. It is the sum of a fixed base salary plus incentives at target performance. Incentive compensation will vary based on performance. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact. 

 We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role. 

 We have two geographic pay zones in the United States: 

 Zone 1 (New York, California, Washington) : $220,000– $330,000 OTE 

 Zone 2 (All other US states) : $200,000 – $300,000 OTE 

 These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. title: Sr Phlebotomist - Oak Ridge, TN at Natera
description:
****This is an onsite position in Oak Ridge, Tennessee**** 

 POSITION SUMMARY 

 A Sr Phlebotomist serves patients by identifying the best method for retrieving blood; preparing specimens for laboratory testing; and performing screening procedures. 

 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Verifies test requisitions by comparing information with nursing station log; bringing discrepancies to the attention of unit personnel. 
 Verifies patient by reading patient identification. 
 Obtains blood specimens by performing venipunctures and finger sticks. 
 Maintains specimen integrity by using aseptic technique, following department procedures; observing isolation procedures. 
 Tracks collected specimens by initialing, dating, and noting times of collection; maintaining daily tallies of collections performed. 
 Maintains quality results by following department procedures and testing schedule; recording results in the quality-control log; identifying and reporting needed changes. 
 Maintains safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complying with legal regulations. 
 Resolves unusual test orders by contacting the physician, pathologist, nursing station, or reference laboratory; referring unresolved orders back to the originator for further clarification; notifying supervisor of unresolved orders. 
 Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations. 
 Enhances phlebotomy department and hospital reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.

 Work in an office setting with scrubs required 
 The position requires tracking of each draw

title: Project Manager - Latin America - Remote at Azumo
description:
Azumo is looking for a Project Manager to lead software development projects and personalized technology initiatives from inception to delivery. 

 As a Project Manager, you will be a key player within our IT Delivery team, collaborating cross-functionally with both business and technical teams. You will bring structure, accountability, and technical credibility to every engagement, bridging the gap between engineering teams and stakeholders with clarity and confidence. 

 This is a hands-on, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and uses modern tools, including AI, to deliver better outcomes. 

 The position is FULLY REMOTE, based in Latin America. 

 Responsibilities: 

 Project Delivery 

 
 Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of software development projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, and budget constraints. 
 Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines across all engagements. 
 Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate project risks and blockers, maintaining a live risk log and escalating issues with recommended solutions. 
 Manage vendor and third-party relationships relevant to project delivery, including tracking SLAs and delivery commitments. 
 

 Agile Execution 

 
 Apply Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies to manage project workflows, maintain healthy backlogs, and ensure timely, iterative delivery of software solutions. 
 Facilitate Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives) ensuring actionable outcomes from each session. 
 

 Financial & Resources 

 
 Own billing, time tracking, and budget management across projects, including forecasting and variance analysis. 
 Plan and optimize resource allocation to ensure the right people are on the right tasks at the right time. 
 

 Team Leadership 

 
 Lead and support cross-functional teams through performance coaching, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, fostering a high-accountability culture. 
 

 Reporting & Documentation 

 
 Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation: timelines, risk registers, status reports, RACI matrices, and resource allocation plans. 
 Communicate clear project updates, escalations, and strategic insights to senior management and stakeholders using structured reporting cadences. 
 

 AI- Powered Delivery 

 
 Leverage AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, and Jira automation, to improve delivery efficiency, generate status reports, assist in documentation drafting, and identify project risks proactively. 
 

 Basic Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 5+ years of experience managing software development projects across the full SDLC. 
 Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a bias for action. 
 Hands-on experience with JIRA and Notion for project tracking and documentation. 
 Demonstrated use of AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, Copilot) in a professional project delivery context. 
 Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while consistently meeting deadlines. 
 Professional English proficiency (C1/C2) 
 Based in Latin America. 
 

 Nice to have: 

 
 Previous experience as a Software Developer, Technical Lead, enables tighter collaboration with engineering teams and more accurate technical scoping. 
 Hands-on familiarity with software development workflows: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, API concepts, or sprint-level technical reviews. 
 Experience delivering AI, ML, or data-driven software projects, a meaningful advantage given Azumo’s specialization. 
 Familiarity with prompt engineering applied to documentation, reporting, or team productivity workflows. 
 

 Company benefits include: 

 
 Paid Time Off 
 Mentored Career Development 
 U.S. Holidays 
 USD Remuneration 
 Profit Sharing 
 Maternity Coverage 
 100% Remote

title: Research Associate - Los Angeles Office at Murphy Research
description:
Murphy Research is a full-service custom market research firm known for our innovative research design and consultative approach. We produce groundbreaking qualitative and quantitative research through our focus on creative design, rigorous execution, and enduring insights. Our team thinks out of the box, follows a steady execution process, and is empowered to produce the highest quality research product that truly matters to our clients. At Murphy Research, we make difficult decisions easy. 

 We are actively seeking full-time Research Associates to join the Murphy Research consulting team. In this role, you will assist in the development, execution, and analysis of projects for a diverse range of Fortune 500 companies. All of our consulting researchers work across industries on diverse projects with clients like Gatorade, Disney, Visa, Door Dash, and Waymo. This is an exciting opportunity to launch your research consulting career as you support some of the world’s most prominent brands with market assessment, brand strategy, product development, customer loyalty and engagement, and communications research. 

 About You: 

 
 You have a background in the social sciences: degree or lab experience in psychology, sociology, or anthropology preferred; you’re familiar with quantitative and qualitative research methods from coursework, internships, or work experience 
 You’ve made the decision not to pursue a career in academic research. Instead, you’re eager to apply your knowledge of research methods toward business strategies and help our clients make difficult decisions easier 
 You put client-service first while maintaining high expectations for quality work under fast-paced, ever-changing, and stressful circumstances 
 You delight the clients you serve and thrive when challenged by changes and new opportunities 
 You understand the importance of time management and the need to prioritize as you work on several projects simultaneously 
 You love teamwork and collaboration just as much as working independently 
 You are skilled at engaging with colleagues and clients in a virtual environment and you don’t shy away from asking a question or adding your voice to the conversation on zoom 
 Your communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills are points of strength 
 You possess an ambitious curiosity and are self-motivated to take initiative 
 You’re excited about pursuing a career working with top-notch brands in an ever-changing and dynamic environment that will be as challenging as it is rewarding 
 

 What You’ll Be Doing: 

 
 In a fast-paced and deadline-driven consulting environment, you will utilize strong strategic thinking and analytic skill 
 You will collaborate with a team of researchers to execute study progress against tight project deadlines 
 With strong support from senior leadership, you’ll receive on-the-job training and mentorship in project management, data processing, questionnaire design, report writing, and research methodology to ensure research is of the highest quality 
 Utilizing our rigorous project process you will manage vendor relationships, oversee data collection, address quality control issues with online programs, data tables, reports, and develop PPT report charts 
 You will work with large data sets, so an eye for detail is key; your proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is a must! 
 You will trust that career growth stems from the challenge inherent to custom market research designs - never doing the same thing twice; doing so, you’ll launch and develop your career as a strong analyst, project manager, and research consultant 
 

 What We Offer: 

 
 Daily opportunity for variety, challenge, and growth 
 Great training, career advancement, and mentorship opportunities 
 A collaborative, team-oriented, and high-performing atmosphere 
 Starting Salary Range: $50,000 - $52,000 
 Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401k matching, paid time off, in-person and virtual social activities 
 A commitment to a hybrid work model (all new hires must live within commuting distance of our Century City co-working space and join the team Tuesdays & Thursdays in-office); all team members also retain the support structure and flexibility to work remotely on non-office days. 
 

 Application Details: 

 
 Applying to this posting means you are located in CA - specifically Los Angeles 
 Applying to this listing means you live within commuting distance of our Century City co-working space and are committed to joining the team Tuesdays & Thursdays in-office 
 Relocation is not offered; Murphy Research can only hire in the states of CA or MN at this time. In your application, please indicate which city you plan to work/reside. 
 Applications will be considered on a rolling basis and will remain open until all current positions are filled.

title: Software Engineer II - Collaborative Web Platform at Pantheon
description:
About Pantheon 

 Pantheon brings together exceptional builders who take ownership, drive meaningful impact, and shape what’s next for the web. We power more than 300,000 websites globally for organizations including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, Clorox, and the United Nations. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers use our WebOps platform to build, iterate, and scale WordPress, Drupal, and Next.js sites that reach billions of people worldwide. As an employer, we operate with the same philosophy that drives our product: foundation and freedom. Pantheon is a vibrant, remote-forward team of experts who care deeply about their craft and results. Here, you take ownership of work that matters, contribute alongside exceptional people, and see the impact you create. 

 The Opportunity 

 Pantheon is building the next generation of web content infrastructure — a real-time, collaborative platform that redefines how teams create, publish, and manage content on the modern web. Content management has been largely unchanged for two decades. We are changing that. 

 As a Software Engineer II on this team, you will be an early engineer on a founding-stage product with real momentum behind it. You will build features end-to-end, contribute to architectural decisions, and work alongside a small, senior team that moves fast and cares deeply about craft. This is not a role where you wait for tickets — it is a role where you help define what gets built and how. 

 The Role 

 You will work across the full stack — backend services, APIs, and frontend systems — building the core capabilities of a real-time collaborative content platform. You will work closely with a small team of engineers, as well as product and design partners, to ship features that developers and content teams rely on every day. 

 This team is early-stage by design. The product is being defined as it is built, and every engineer on the team has a meaningful voice in that process. If you are energized by that kind of environment, this is the right place. 

 What You Need to Succeed 

 
 Build and ship full-stack features across backend services, APIs, and frontend interfaces 
 Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with shared ownership of quality 
 Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions as an active participant, not just an implementer 
 Collaborate closely with product and design to translate requirements into working, well-crafted software 
 Integrate AI tooling into your development workflow and into the product itself 
 Participate in code review and help maintain a high engineering bar across the team 
 Learn and grow quickly — this is a team that will stretch you in the best possible way 
 

 What You Bring to the Table 

 
 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience 
 Solid full-stack capability — you have shipped production code on both backend and frontend, and you are willing to stretch into whichever side a problem requires 
 Experience with modern API design: REST, GraphQL, or webhooks 
 Comfortable working in cloud-native environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure) 
 Strong fundamentals: you write tests, understand tradeoffs, and think about maintainability 
 Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 
 You are actively building with AI — using it in your development workflow or integrating it into the products you work on. 
 

 What We Offer 

 We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team. 

 
 Industry competitive compensation and equity plan 
 Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave (PSL) and 12 Paid Company Holidays 
 Full medical coverage (Extended health care, dental, vision) 
 Top-of-line equipment 
 In-office workspace (Vancouver, BC Canada) 
 Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development 
 Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate 
 

 Pantheon is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law. Pantheon complies with federal and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability for any part of the interview process, please contact talent@pantheon.io. Pursuant to local and federal regulations, Pantheon will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment. 

 To review the Employee and Applicant’s Privacy Policy, click here. 

 Visa Sponsorship is not available at this time. 

 The Canadian base salary range for this position is 103,206 - 129,008 CAD per year. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. At Pantheon, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.
